% A document written the LaTeX way, for an engine with packages. Everything in
% this preamble is an idiom the compat layer rewrites into a native declaration;
% `leantex -v` lists each one with its shorter spelling. Invented content.

\documentclass[paper=a5,fontsize=11pt]{scrartcl}

\usepackage{xcolor}
\definecolor{deepwater}{HTML}{1F4E5F}
\definecolor{driftwood}{rgb}{0.47,0.41,0.33}
\definecolor{foam}{HTML}{B8D8CF}
\colorlet{oarblade}{driftwood}

\usepackage[english]{babel}
\babelfont{rm}[Path=fonts/]{SourceSerifPro-Regular.otf}
\babelfont{sf}[Path=fonts/]{OpenSans-Regular.ttf}
\usepackage[a5paper, vmargin=14mm, hmargin=17mm, headsep=5mm]{geometry}
\usepackage{microtype}

\newlength{\beat}
\setlength{\beat}{2.2ex plus 0.6ex minus 0.3ex\relax}
\newlength{\stroke}
\setlength{\stroke}{0.75\beat}
\linespread{1.12}

\usepackage{scrlayer-scrpage}
\clearpairofpagestyles
\ihead{\itshape Harbour Rowing Club}
\ohead{\thepage}
\pagestyle{scrheadings}

% Element styling the KOMA and enumitem way; each becomes one \style{...}.
\makeatletter
\renewcommand\sectionlinesformat[4]{#3#4\quad\textcolor{foam}{\leaders\hrule height 1.1pt\hfill}}
\makeatother
\RedeclareSectionCommand[beforeskip=2\stroke,afterskip=1\stroke]{section}
\setkomafont{section}{\Large\sffamily\itshape\color{deepwater}}
\setlist[itemize]{label={\textcolor{oarblade}{\footnotesize\textbullet}}, leftmargin=1.6em, itemsep=\stroke, topsep=\stroke}

\newcommand{\boat}[2]{\textit{#1}: #2.\par}
\NewDocumentCommand{\boatsep}{}{\ \textbullet\ }
\NewDocumentCommand{\fixture}{m m m o}{%
    \textsc{#3}\quad\textbf{#1}, #2\IfValueT{#4}{ (\textit{#4})}\par
}

\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage{soul}
\hypersetup{
    pdftitle={Spring Bulletin},
    pdfauthor={Harbour Rowing Club},
    colorlinks=false,
    pdfborder={0 0 0}
}
\thispagestyle{empty}

\begin{document}
\color{deepwater}

\begin{center}
    {\LARGE\sffamily\bfseries Spring \textcolor{driftwood}{Bulletin}\par}
    \vspace{2\stroke}
    {\color{driftwood} crew@example.org\boatsep example.org/harbour}
\end{center}

\section*{Fixtures}

\begin{itemize}
    \item Launch from the north pontoon; the tide turns at ten.

\vspace{2\stroke}
\fixture{Lower Reach}{single sculls}{Sun 15:00}

\section*{Boats}

\boat{Kestrel}{a coxed four rigged for bow side}

% The hand-aligned pair: `Novice` carries no descender, so its box is
% shallower than `Trophy`'s and the two would sit on different baselines.
% \vphantom props the depth by hand — the idiom this line exists to keep
% working, argument and all, without that argument ever reaching the page.
\noindent\textbf{Novice\vphantom{gj}} and \textbf{Trophy} share the shelf this season.\par

\ul{Race reports} follow, rowed \varul<3>[0.25ex][0.08ex]{remarkably steadily} into a headwind.
